notes.body:
added 2 commits
  • d3f2fa40 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 69e1aa86 - Fix many spelling errors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/545/diffs?diff_id=117410655&start_sha=23d8cf04310759e981df9803bf2bc0cd5e29dbdd)

There are likely thousands of spelling errors in code comments, I'm not sure its worth anyone's time to check them all (especially if the meaning was clear).

tools/check_spelling.py only checks the spelling in documents and strings within code files (i.e. where users are likely to see them).  Even there, I'm sure I fixed lots of words that are unlikely to be seen by human eyes ever again :)
